title: 第345章 三百年的梦第344章 洛一的后手
content_zh:
第345章三百年的梦
亚空间的光，已经浓稠得近乎液态。
金色的光流从穹顶倾注而下，如同一座倒悬的海洋正在缓慢地灌入这片被折叠的空间。
每一寸空气都在灼烧，光尘在视野里浮动，像亿万只细小的虫豸在啃噬着现实的边界。
拉赫斯站在那片金色的风暴中央，银白色的法杖横于身前，法袍被气流吹得猎猎翻卷。、
他微微侧过头，花白的须发在光流中如同镀了一层熔金，碧绿的眼眸倒映着前方那片正不断膨胀的神国轮廓。
“所有人，退出亚空间。”
他的声音穿透了光雨与风暴的喧嚣，落在身后每一道身影的耳中。
“——这里交给我。”
几位教授愣住了。
他们的目光触及拉赫斯那双碧绿眼眸中某种决绝的平静时，有人握紧了法杖，有人下意识向前迈了半步，但都没有真的动。
因为他们都听出了那句话里的分量，以及它所预示的结局。
年迈的大贤者侧过身，那背影在金色的光雨中显得单薄，却又如同一堵无声的墙，横亘在那片正在扩张的神国与身后的所有人之间。
艾梵琳的身影从侧前方掠回。
她落在拉赫斯身后不远处，粉色的长发在余波中微微晃动，碧绿的眼眸死死盯着那道年迈的背影。
“你想做什么？”
拉赫斯轻叹一声：“深空学院传承至今，不能在我的手中毁掉。”
艾梵琳看着那道背影，看着那头在光流中泛着银辉的花白头发，看着那双握着法杖的苍老手掌，指节微微凸起，如同老树的根系。
她咬了咬牙：“那森林呢？”
拉赫斯没有回答。

“你死了，妖精之森怎么办？”
艾梵琳往前迈了一步，碧绿的眼眸里像是冰层下的暗流在翻涌。
拉赫斯转过头，慈爱地看着她，轻声道：“艾梵琳，你已经长大了。”
艾梵琳闻言一愣，随即咬牙道：“要我接替你的位置？想都别想！”
“如果你死了……我就一把火烧了精灵母树。”
“……”
拉赫斯一怔，随即，变得无奈。
因为他知道，她说得出，就做得到。
自从那个人死后，他这个孙女就再也不是那个会为了花没开而掉眼泪的小女孩了。
她什么都做得出来。
甚至包括用整个世界来威胁他。
拉赫斯轻轻叹了口气，正准备开口说些什么，然而，正这时。
“——艾梵琳教授，您就别为难大贤者先生了。”
一道声音突然在拉赫斯的手边响起。
拉赫斯的目光微微一顿。
艾梵琳的瞳孔猛然收缩了一瞬。
而更远处，那道一直静立不语的白裙身影——
弗嘉丽猛然转过头，浅金色的眼眸朝着声音传来的方向望去。
content_en:
Chapter 345 Three Hundred Years of Dreams
The light in the subspace has become so thick that it is almost liquid.
The golden stream of light pours down from the dome, like an upside-down ocean slowly pouring into this folded space.
Every inch of the air is burning, and light and dust are floating in the field of vision, like billions of tiny insects gnawing at the boundaries of reality.
Laches stood in the center of the golden storm, his silver-white staff lying in front of him, and his robes were blown by the air current. ,
He turned his head slightly, his gray beard and hair seemed to be plated with molten gold in the light flow, and his green eyes reflected the expanding outline of the Kingdom of God in front of him.
"Everyone, exit the subspace."
His voice penetrated the din of light, rain and storm, and fell on the ears of every figure behind him.
"——Leave this to me."
Several professors were stunned.
When their gazes touched the decisive calmness in Laches's green eyes, some of them tightened their grip on the staff, and some subconsciously took a half-step forward, but none of them really moved.
Because they all heard the weight of that sentence and the outcome it foreshadowed.
The old great sage turned sideways, and his back looked thin in the golden light rain, but it was like a silent wall, standing between the expanding Kingdom of God and everyone behind him.
Evaline's figure swept back from the side.
She landed not far behind Laches, her long pink hair swaying slightly in the aftermath, and her green eyes staring intently at the old figure.
"What do you want to do?"
Laches sighed softly: "Deep Space Academy has been passed down to this day and cannot be destroyed in my hands."
Evaline looked at the back, at the gray hair that glowed silver in the light stream, and at the old hands holding the staff. The knuckles were slightly raised, like the roots of an old tree.
She gritted her teeth: "What about the forest?"
Laches didn't answer.
"If you die, what will happen to the Fairy Forest?"
Evaline took a step forward, her green eyes seemed like undercurrents surging under the ice.
Laches turned his head, looked at her lovingly, and said softly: "Evaline, you have grown up."
Ai Fanlin was stunned when she heard this, then gritted her teeth and said: "You want me to take over your position? Don't even think about it!"
"If you die...I will burn the Elf Mother Tree with fire."
"..."
Laches was startled, and then became helpless.
Because he knew that if she could say it, she could do it.
Since that man's death, his granddaughter is no longer the little girl who sheds tears because the flowers have not bloomed.
She can do anything.
Even threatening him with the whole world.
Laches sighed softly and was about to say something, but at this moment.
"——Professor Eveline, please don't embarrass Mr. Great Sage."
A voice suddenly sounded near Laches' hand.
Laches's eyes paused slightly.
Evelin's pupils suddenly shrank for a moment.
And further away, the figure in a white dress who had been standing silently——
Fujiali suddenly turned her head and looked in the direction of the sound with her light golden eyes.
